prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Katy, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1494; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking space at a grocery store in Katy, Texas, when my vehicle was struck on the rear passenger side by another car that came down the aisle faster than I expected. I had just checked my mirrors and was moving slowly, so the impact was sharp enough to jolt me forward and against the steering wheel. My right wrist took most of the force as I caught myself. I was taken to a local clinic, where an X-ray showed a fracture, and I have been wearing a splint since. I have described what happened the same way to the adjuster, to the clinic staff, and to the officer who responded, and I have not changed any detail. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating the vehicle with permission and in the way the policy requires.
